## Problem statement

What gap or ambiguity are you addressing?

## Proposed change

Describe the field, semantic, lifecycle, or transport guidance change.

## Normative or non-normative

State whether the change affects normative behaviour.

## Compatibility impact

Explain any effect on existing schemas, examples, or SDKs.

## Alternatives considered

Describe other approaches and why you prefer this one.
